name: spellglow
does: The creatures' spells glow (a bright core, a dithered halo, a pool of light on the ground, a few real lights); 0 draws them without it, as before 9 November, and old draws the glow at its strength before 16 November, to compare.
decision: Glowing by default (Ed, 2026-11-09: "The animal magic effects need to glow."), and stronger since Ed, 2026-11-16 ("Stronger")
